role: Meta-gate (make verify-gates; ci.yml lint-and-budgets 'Gates actually fail'; not in gates.yml) that, for 88 named cases, confirms a gate is green, plants a violation in a file via a python one-liner, requires the gate to exit non-zero, and restores the file; then requires every scripts/check_*.sh and enforce_*.sh except the build-only coverage gate to be run by one of those cases.
state: file:temp backup dir (also holds the stand-in xcodebuild, its suite-race fixture and a one-file citation root)
file:many tracked files mutated and restored (README.md, Localizable.xcstrings, pbxproj, Package.resolved, .ci budgets, sources, scripts/check_thread_sanitizer.sh...)
toplevel: set -uo pipefail; cd to repo root. Acquires the tree lock, sets the EXIT/INT/TERM/HUP trap (restore_all, rm the backup dir if set, release lock) before creating the backup dir with gate_mktemp_dir (|| exit), so a failed creation cannot leave the lock behind. Runs each `check` call in order. The cases cover copy linter, doc links, CloudKit (including a health field outside any fixed name list), privacy manifest, developer endpoint (including a missing Package.resolved), xcodebuild package pinning, strict concurrency, gate preflight, snapshot refs, empty ranges, doc counts, date-ms, SBOM, spec conformance, localization (bundle, resolution, orphans, format args, coverage), log redaction (including a Watch Logger call, a user query and a saved-route name), sendable (including a decimal budget), orphan swift, comment citations (including a source root with no Swift), gates wired, eager prompts, locale formatting (including a Watch decimal), fixed fonts, skip budget, budget monotonicity (with HEAD; including a ceiling made decimal), aggregate type size, tech-debt (including a Watch `.shared` and a decimal budget), leaked mutations, infoplist drift, perimeter sync, swiftlint budget, sbom drift, science register, scoring governance (constants changed without a bump, a version bump without the baseline, and a file whose constants the pattern no longer matches), no-unowned, HR feed, CoreMotion isolation, licence headers, logger self-reference, dated comments (including a decimal budget), shared-outside-root, explicit dependencies, uitest fresh install, three code-map cases (an unrecorded function, a changed body, and a high-severity flag in a temporary overlay pointed at through CODEMAP_OVERLAY; the code-map gate command uses .venv-codemap/bin/python when it exists, else python3), and the Thread Sanitizer gate run against a stand-in xcodebuild written to the backup dir: it emits a race report only when -parallel-testing-enabled NO is passed and fails the run on a race only when TEST_RUNNER_TSAN_OPTIONS has halt_on_error=1; the canary selector races when TEST_RUNNER_EMUQU_TSAN_CANARY=1, the suite when the fixture says so. Its plants are a race in the suite, and each of those two settings removed from check_thread_sanitizer.sh. A TODO(codemap-recheck) comment marks where the re-check case returns once re-check lines fail the check again. Prints PASS/FAIL/SKIP totals. Meta-check: for every scripts/check_*.sh and enforce_*.sh except check_gate_preflight.sh and NEEDS_BUILD (check_coverage.sh), a non-comment line that is a quoted case argument or a NAME="…" command must invoke `./scripts/<basename>`; a gate only named in a comment or message counts as unplanted -> exit 1. Then removes PlantedOrphan.swift; exits 1 if FAIL>0, and exits 1 if SKIP>0 (a gate already red or a plant that could not be applied is not a verified gate).

units.does: Copies file $1 to the backup dir under its path with '/' replaced by '_' and appends it to TOUCHED.
Copies every TOUCHED file's backup back over it (skipping missing backups), then clears TOUCHED.
units.entry: also run from the EXIT/INT/TERM/HUP trap

units.does: Runs one plant case: skips unless name matches FILTER; evals the gate (must be green, else SKIP); backs up the file; runs the python mutation (failure -> restore, SKIP); evals the gate again, restores, and records PASS if it exited non-zero or FAIL if it stayed green.

branches.cond: FILTER set and name does not contain it

branches.effect: print SKIP 'already red', SKIP++, return (not a failure)

branches.cond: mutation script fails (e.g. assert on anchor)
